questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this service turns failures into HTTP error responses? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Cancelling a shipment that has already been delivered makes the service throw InvalidStateTransitionError("delivered", "cancelled"). What does the client receive?
choices: 409 with detail "delivered -> cancelled is not allowed"

questions.prompt: An error is thrown after the label route has already started streaming its response. What does problemHandler do?
choices: Passes the error to express's default handler via next(err) without writing a problem body
Writes a 500 problem+json body after the partial response

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the instance field the handler adds to each problem?
choices: It names the error class for clients to switch on
It identifies the specific request URL the problem occurred on, distinct from the reusable type
It holds the HTTP status as a string
It carries the stack trace for debugging
